title: Where You Go, I Will Go

request.style: English, musical theatre duet, an older mezzo-soprano as the mother-in-law and a young soprano as the daughter-in-law, singing in turn and then in harmony, theatre orchestra with strings and oboe, heartfelt, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Go back, my daughters, each to her mother's house
May the Lord deal kindly with you
As you have dealt with the dead and with me
Go back, there is nothing for you with me

[Verse]
Do not urge me to leave you
Or to return from following you
For where you go, I will go
And where you lodge, I will lodge

[Chorus]
Your people shall be my people
And your God my God
Where you die, I will die
And there I will be buried

[Verse]
Turn back like your sister has turned
Back to her people and her gods
No, I will not leave you
May the Lord do so to me if anything but death parts me from you

[Chorus]
Your people shall be my people
And your God my God
Where you die, I will die
And there I will be buried
